meta.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA: text ≥ 4.5:1 (≥ 3:1 at 24px+), control boundaries, focus rings and meaningful marks ≥ 3:1, verified in both themes for every hue-* accent.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Theme follows prefers-color-scheme. At runtime it takes a 7% tint of the active accent (color-mix(in oklab, accent 7%, bg)); every text pair below is verified on the tinted ground too.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Translucent floating surfaces (cards, panels) with blur-surface, a line hairline and shadow-float.

tokens.name: surface-dock
tokens.usage: The Dock and its back button: near-opaque so controls stay legible over any content behind.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Opaque base that media stages and tiles tint from; swatch rim.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-dock, surface-2 and tile tints (≥ 13:1 on bg in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, meta, eyebrows) on the same grounds as fg: ≥ 4.5:1 everywhere, including every tile tint.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: DECORATIVE hairline of floating surfaces only. Never the boundary that identifies a control: use border-control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of interactive controls that have no fill (outline chips, search field, secondary buttons): ≥ 3:1 on every ground (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: DYNAMIC fill colour. Default = hue-violet; at runtime any source colour is turned into an accent with vivid() (OKLCH chroma ×1.6, lightness 0.64–0.74) and set with AccentScope. Fills always carry on-accent content; states shown by a fill also get an icon or text (an accent fill can be under 3:1 against the light ground).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Computed per accent: dark ink or white, whichever contrasts more; ≥ 4.5:1 for every hue-* (5.2:1 on the default).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds (highlighted row, positive list, hover). Runtime: color-mix(in oklab, accent 16%, transparent).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as TEXT, meaningful marks (rings, sliders, selected outlines) and focus ring, on bg, surfaces, tiles and accent-soft: ≥ 4.5:1 for every hue-* in both themes. Runtime: color-mix(in oklab, accent 45%, fg).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element (≥ 3:1 on all grounds).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive state TEXT and icons; always paired with an icon or word (never colour alone). ≥ 4.5:1 on all grounds.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution state text and icons, with an icon or word. ≥ 4.5:1 on all grounds.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error state text and icons, with an icon or word; differs from success in lightness as well as hue. ≥ 4.5:1 on all grounds.

tokens.name: hue-red
tokens.usage: Accent preset. Dark on-accent.

tokens.name: hue-orange
tokens.usage: Accent preset. Dark on-accent.

tokens.name: hue-amber
tokens.usage: Accent preset. Dark on-accent.

tokens.name: hue-green
tokens.usage: Accent preset. Dark on-accent.

tokens.name: hue-teal
tokens.usage: Accent preset. Dark on-accent.

tokens.name: hue-sky
tokens.usage: Accent preset. Dark on-accent.

tokens.name: hue-blue
tokens.usage: Accent preset. Dark on-accent.

tokens.name: hue-violet
tokens.usage: Accent preset and default accent. Dark on-accent.

tokens.name: hue-pink
tokens.usage: Accent preset. Dark on-accent.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page question or hero, one per page. 34px below 640px.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Un testo introduttivo breve, leggibile e scritto in modo diretto.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Il corpo del testo usa righe di massimo 70 caratteri e interlinea 1.6.
styles.usage: Default text. Never smaller for paragraphs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines and counts, in muted. Not for paragraphs.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Short labels above titles, UPPERCASE, in muted; max 4 words.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, gaps inside the Dock row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gap on phones; gaps inside groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; Dock distance from the bottom edge on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; Dock distance from the bottom on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large panel padding; vertical rhythm between sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of pages that show the Dock.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tiles inside rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, small panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Media stages inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-dock
tokens.usage: The Dock bar.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Tiles of the entry grid (the items of the collapse transition).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Large panels and hero stages.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dock pill, round buttons, chips, badges, swatches.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Every floating surface. Light: tinted by the accent at runtime.

tokens.name: blur-surface
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on surfaces and the Dock, with saturate(1.4).

tokens.name: blur-stage
tokens.usage: Blob inside media stages; 40px inside tiles.

tokens.name: blur-ambient
tokens.usage: Page-level ambient blobs.

tokens.name: blur-goo
tokens.usage: Gaussian blur of the collapse goo filter (with an alpha threshold of 22 / −9): sets how wide the liquid bridges between cells are.

tokens.name: blob-opacity-light
tokens.usage: Ambient blobs, light theme.

tokens.name: blob-opacity-dark
tokens.usage: Ambient blobs, dark theme.
